intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes NextRIP handling in nested virtualization to prevent using stale control values during save/restore or subsequent L2 runs after the initial VMRUN.
intent_record.what: Restructured the NextRIP assignment logic in nested_vmcb02_prepare_control() by adding a check for !svm->nested.nested_run_pending alongside the X86_FEATURE_NRIPS check. Also expanded the comment to clarify that NextRIP should only come from svm->nested.ctl.next_rip on the first L2 run after VMRUN, but should use vmcb12_rip during save/restore or subsequent runs.
intent_record.how: Prevents overwriting CPU/KVM-updated NextRIP values during save/restore or subsequent L2 runs by checking nested_run_pending state. Ensures that after the initial VMRUN, the actual L2 RIP from vmcb12 is used instead of potentially stale ctl.next_rip values, matching hardware behavior when nrips=0.
